description.en: Stylized complete living Helianthaster restoration; lost arm lengths/repeats, upper soft covering, color, thickness, bends, plate relief and nominal 0.20 m spread are artistic and unmeasured. Original scope supplies 15 fixed views and no turntable; additive record compatibility does not erase historical formal errors.
description.zh: Helianthaster完整活体风格化复原；缺失腕长/重复、软覆盖、颜色、厚度、弯曲、骨板起伏和名义0.20米展幅均含未测量艺术补全。原范围为15固定视图、无转台；记录兼容适配不抹去历史formal错误。

reconstruction_notes: Complete living restoration; lost arm lengths/repeats, low domed upper soft covering, color, modest thickness, slight bends, exact plate relief and nominal 0.20 m spread are artistic and unmeasured. Oral central region is closed, not a through-hole.
author: Leon Made This / s010s
acceptance_scope: Original frozen scoped independent model review with retained advisories; no blanket formal/GPU/neighbor/reproducibility or user visual approval. Website image review remains separate.
scale_scope: Nominal authored display dimensions; not new specimen metrology.
